# Documentation templates

Copy a template, fill every section, delete guidance comments. Rules: [STANDARDS.md](../STANDARDS.md).

| Template | Use for |
|---|---|
| [adr.md](adr.md) | A hard-to-reverse decision |
| [design-doc.md](design-doc.md) | A proposal not yet shipped |
| [reference.md](reference.md) | Exact facts: fields, flags, endpoints, env vars |
| [guide.md](guide.md) | Task-oriented how-to |
| [runbook.md](runbook.md) | On-call procedure for a symptom |

Existing templates that stay in their folders: [feature spec](../specs/feature-spec-template.md), [change plan](../plans/change-plan-template.md), [report](../reports/report-template.md), [BDD scenario](../testing/bdd-scenario-template.md).
